newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Metroplex in Australian casino deal.
newsitem.headline: Metroplex in Australian casino deal.

text.p: Metroplex Bhd said on Tuesday that it has agreed to buy all the assets and management rights of Victoria Co (Resort) Pty Ltd's Burswood Resort Casino in Perth, Australia, for A$93 million.

In a statement, Metroplex said it will also lease the Burswood Resort Hotel for 20 years. Metroplex earlier this month said it was restructuring to shift from a property development to a hotel and leisure concern.
Metroplex said the Burswood Casino is one of the most successful casinos in Australia "with one of the highest junket arrivals in the region".
As part of the rights to management, Metroplex will also take over the operations of Burswood Convention Centre and Burswood Dome, a sporting and special events venue.
As operator of the casino, convention centre and dome, Metroplex said it will receive management fees based on gross revenues and income of the resort.
Metroplex already is involved in hotels and casinos in Subic Bay and Manila, in the Philippines as well as in Malaysia.
